_meta.format: id-based chain (depends_on + input_from + expect) over the OBJECT-GENERIC atoms (create_object/get_object/update_object/delete_object). Each step passes `object` + a `fields` bag; the per-object GraphQL is dispatched by resolve_object from the object schema's graphql descriptor. session_api (kind: graphql) is the proven path.
_meta.purpose: The CRUDS reference run-chain (Rule Q era): create_object Client → create_object Property (Property→Client via fields.clientId) → create_object Job (Job→Property via fields.propertyId) → get_object Job + ASSERT the 2-hop link → update_object → self-cleaning delete_object. Proves the generic dispatch + reference resolution across create→create→create + the round-trip on read-back.
notes: The reference is injected into the `fields` bag via a NESTED input_from path (fields.clientId ← create_client.outcomes.record_id); the E2E run-chain runner must support nested-path input_from for this to drive (the mechanism was proven LIVE via direct GraphQL 2026-07-08 — see jobber.md).
run_token tags every record; sampleData:true isolates + sweeps test data.
Quote/Invoice/Visit create need richer required `fields` (lineItems / origin+dueDetails+tax / nested visit) — enumerated by their schema descriptors, not driven here.
invalid_input is unit-proven (platform-api reject_path) + live-confirmed (jobCreate bogus propertyId → userErrors 'Property not found').
